metadata.title: एमपी में लुस-पुस जलता पौष्टिक चावल | Fortified Rice - Misconceptions or Failure | बैगा आदिवासी
metadata.description:
In this eye-opening ground report/explainer from the Mandla district of Madhya Pradesh, India, we delve into the government's ambitious plans to eradicate diseases like sickle cell from tribal communities. Despite the promising initiative outlined in the 2023 budget, we shed light on the challenges faced in implementation.

Our investigation reveals a significant hurdle: the distribution of fortified rice in tribal areas, intended to improve nutrition and combat diseases, is being met with scepticism and misconceptions among the tribal population. Many tribals hold the belief that the fortified rice provided by the government is actually plastic rice, undermining trust in the program.

This report exposes the lack of awareness campaigns and monitoring mechanisms that have contributed to the failure of these schemes. 

By sharing this report, we aim to raise awareness about the urgent need for effective communication, education, and monitoring in the government's efforts to eradicate diseases like sickle cell from tribal India. Join us as we shed light on the challenges faced by these communities and explore potential solutions to ensure the success of this crucial public health initiative.
